onChangeCurrentSlide.description: The function called when the current slide has changed.

onSlideShowBegin.description: The function called when a slide show presentation starts.

onSlideShowEnd.description: The function called when a slide show presentation ends.

onSlideShowNextSlide.description:
The function called after a slide has been changed and displayed during a slide show presentation.
Fires before the slide content is actually displayed.

onSlideShowSlideChanged.description: The function called when slide changes during a slide show presentation. Provides information about both the current and previous slide.
